note: The OLG does not mention Workers' Compensation by name anywhere — a grep of all scraped OLG data returns zero results for 'Workers Compensation' or any variant. The OLG also has general collateral contact procedures (Cross Programs > Verifications > Verification Methods > Collateral Contact). However, two specific FNS requirements are not met: (1) FNS specifies the Workers' Compensation award notice as 'best evidence,' establishing a verification hierarchy — the OLG lists acceptable documents without ranking them; (2) FNS requires contacting the Workers' Compensation office as a specific fallback when the award notice is unavailable — the OLG's general collateral contact guidance does not identify the WC office as a specific verification source. The generic verification framework partially covers the requirement, but the absence of Workers' Compensation-specific guidance means workers have no explicit instruction for this income type.
